matches.rationale: Finding 2 identifies the exact inconsistency: Theorem 2.1's gap condition (4||E||≤δ_p) conflicts with Lemma 3.1's stated stronger condition (δ_p>5||E||), matching the cross-passage inequality mismatch described in the ground truth.

No finding addresses the ambiguity of whether the maximum in Theorem 2.3 is taken over the boundary or interior of Γ1; Finding 3 discusses a different issue (validity of 'best rank-p approximation' claim for non-monotone f), and no other finding mentions the Γ1 max notation ambiguity.
